title: Keyturn Trip Booking Conditions: Cancellation, No-Show and Rebooking Credit Figures by Rate Plan
content:
These are the figures each Keyturn Trip Booking rate plan carries for ending a reservation before the trip starts: the hours after confirmation during which cancellation costs nothing, the percentage of one day's rate charged when cancelling after that window, the flat component added to a chargeable cancellation, the ceiling on a cancellation fee, the minutes after the scheduled start before a guest counts as a no-show, the no-show fee itself, the percentage of the trip price credited when the marketplace has to rebook the guest, and the calendar days that credit stays usable for.

| Rate plan | Free cancellation window (hours) | Fee after the window (per cent of one day's rate) | Flat component (USD) | Cap on the fee (USD) | No-show grace (minutes) | No-show fee (USD) | Rebooking credit (per cent of trip price) | Credit validity (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan | 1 | 25 | 9.50 | 45.00 | 30 | 35.00 | 10 | 30 |
| Keyturn Daily Rate Plan | 24 | 50 | 0.00 | 350.00 | 60 | 75.00 | 8 | 45 |
| Keyturn Weekend Rate Plan | 48 | 50 | 0.00 | 400.00 | 60 | 85.00 | 8 | 45 |
| Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan | 72 | 40 | 0.00 | 600.00 | 90 | 110.00 | 10 | 60 |
| Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan | 168 | 35 | 0.00 | 900.00 | 120 | 150.00 | 12 | 90 |
| Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan | 240 | 30 | 0.00 | 1200.00 | 180 | 200.00 | 15 | 120 |

### Distinguishing the plans

The free cancellation window widens sharply with the length of the plan, from 1 hour on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan to 240 hours on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan. The percentage charged after the window moves the other way, from 50 per cent at the middle of the ladder down to 30 per cent at the top, and it is 25 per cent on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan.

Only the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan carries a flat component, at 9.50 USD; on the other five plans that figure is 0.00 USD. The rebooking credit percentage is likewise not monotonic: it is 10 per cent on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan, dips to 8 per cent on the Keyturn Daily and Weekend Rate Plans, returns to 10 per cent on the Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan and then rises to 12 and 15 per cent.
